items.b: 4,256 pages on Wikisource mention Uganda, written from 2002 onward and read 1,187,960 times since July 2015. The median page has been read 58 times.
“Motif-Index of Folk-Literature/Volume 1” alone holds 4.3% of all views, and the ten most read pages hold 21%. Readership is spread across many pages rather than a few.
Views peaked in 2025 at 263,973. The last full year, 2025, drew 263,973, close to the peak. So far in 2026: 255,302 views.

Most pages were written in 2025 (1259). In the last five calendar years (2022–2026, the last one part-way) 2,916 pages were written, against 455 in the five years before that — the pace is picking up.
499 registered accounts have edited these pages in all. Editors peaked in 2025 (89); in 2025 there were 89.
27% of pages are stubs (under 1,000 bytes) and 2% are long (20,000 bytes and over).
“No Wikidata item” affects 3,951 pages (93%). Suggested action: Connect to Wikidata.
7% of pages are linked to a Wikidata item, and 7% have no Luganda article for the subject — 303 candidates for translation.
43% of pages were edited in the last year; 873 (21%) have not been touched for five years or more.
Among people with a recorded gender, 22% are women (4 women, 14 men).
